LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_SettingsUnavailable: Could not read the settings. This patch keeps working with its built-in defaults (all fixes on).
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_KeepLeaderTitleDesc:
On: leader titles that are already set (Chairman, Pontiff, ...) are no longer re-rolled by the game. Changing memes or clicking "Randomize symbols" will not touch them. The very first generation of a brand-new ideoligion is unaffected.

Off: fully vanilla behaviour - changing memes or clicking "Randomize symbols" re-rolls the leader title.

To give an ideoligion a different title: clear the title (or temporarily turn this off), then click "Randomize symbols" once.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_FixVfeeInstrumentSpace: Fix the VFE Empire "InstrumentSpace" null-reference crash
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_FixVfeeInstrumentSpaceDes:
On: adds a null guard to the VFE Empire check that would otherwise throw. The room requirements of the nine titles that use "instrument space" (Archcount / Marquess / Archduke / Magister / Despot / HighStellarch, ...) can then work normally.

Off: fully vanilla behaviour.

★ You normally never need to turn this off: the patch first probes whether the vanilla check is still crash-prone and, once it is safe (usually because VFE Empire fixed it), it stands down and does nothing. This switch only matters if the author rewrites the check itself.
